user.title: Set up ESS Manager
user.description: Point this at your own battery, price and solar-forecast entities. All of these can be changed later from the integration's options.

data.name: Name
data.price_entity: Electricity price sensor (Nordpool-style, with today/tomorrow quarter-hour price lists)
data.usage_forecast_entity: Household usage forecast sensor (exposes h0..h120 attributes)
data.solar_forecast_entities: Solar forecast sensor(s) (Solcast-style, with a detailedHourly attribute) - add as many as needed to cover your forecast horizon
data.grid_setpoint_entity: Grid/inverter setpoint sensor (optional, improves status accuracy)
data.voltage_diff_entity: Cell voltage differential sensor (optional, only needed for the full-charge balancing plan)
data.max_soc_percent: Maximum SOC (%) - can exceed 100% to allow deliberate solar overshoot before discharging

error.solar_forecast_required: Select at least one solar forecast entity.

abort.already_configured: An ESS Manager instance with this name already exists.

init.title: ESS Manager options
init.description: Re-point entities or toggle optional plans. Speeds, SOC limits and other tunables are adjusted directly on their own number entities, not here.
